title: DIVIDE ( 0, 0 ) is BLANK, not NaN

source.quote: If an alternate result is not passed in, and the denominator is zero or BLANK, the function returns BLANK
source.supports: a zero denominator gives BLANK whatever the numerator

derivation: The denominator is zero and no alternate result is given, so the result is BLANK.
